'''Goodvalor's''' was a [[restaurant chain]] inspired by the character of "[[Captain]] [[Benegryph Goodvalor]]," the hero of [[Serroco]]. One such restaurant, [[Goodvalor's Little Bivoli]], was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
